about_the_game:
Your regular workday is about to turn into a giant nightmare.

Experience shrinking horror game in an expansive visual novel.

It’s Monday morning and you’re bored at your desk – until your wicked manager shrinks you. Now, you’re only a few inches tall and discovering your coworkers are very dangerous people.

Trapped in an oversized office, you have to run, fight and talk your way past a cast of enormous giantesses (and a giant!) by making one perilous decision after another.

This is the demo of the long-anticipated fully illustrated adaptation of the popular interactive book, including a large portion of the early rooms of the game:

  • 2 of the 8 major characters to encounter!

  • Over 150 images

  • Over 10,000 words of dialogue/narrative text

  • 5 mini-animation cutscenes

  • Play as male or female

  • Two rooms to explore

  • Multiple paths to survival, many paths to doom, but only one route to success!

Get ready for a fast-paced, immersive literary maze packed with chills. Every chapter presents a choice where the slightest wrong move could spell your demise. Can you survive Under the Table?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game features giants who may kill or crush you; players can get swallowed alive and stomped on. The focus is on survival, but as the giants are female these interactions can be considered fetishist.

There is no sexual content or nudity in the demo, but possibilities of being eaten alive or crushed, with internal shots of mouths, throats and stomachs.
